text:
ana: Drafting quick pilot recruitment + gating checklist. Goals: 8-partner cohort, onboarding >=75% in 14 days, automated daily evals for each partner, and a clear triage mapping. Thoughts?
vik: Love it. Ops note: until Dedicated autoscale is validated, cap heavy partners to 4 concurrently. Also require partners to specify peak RPS and max seq length in intake.
tess: I'll own the canonical prompt pack. Suggest 10 prompts: short, long, tool call, structured JSON output, and 2 embedding checks. Partners must run them in week 0 and week 2.
mike: Add a PII checkbox + private-deploy flag in intake. Anything flagged -> private-preview path and Ops + Security loop-in (DPA/KMS).
sam: Success metrics proposal: week-2 NPS >=6/10, median daily tokens >=500 for 50% of cohort, and >=1 logged actionable per partner. Also require top-4 value interviews.
pilot-bot: Intake form: https://internal.redwood/apply/pilot-template  Use partner intake and tag region/workload/private_request.
vik: Feedback routing idea: keyword rules: "accuracy|wrong|regression" -> ML; "latency|timeout|crash" -> eng-runtime; "docs|UX|confusing" -> Product. Weekly digest to #product-pilot-feedback.
tess: I'll add a tiny eval harness (python) that runs the prompt pack daily and emits latency, success-rate, and embedding drift. Need eng-runtime to expose trace IDs and kv-cache hit rate.
mike: Incentives: $1k credit + 3 months priority support for high-signal partners. Legal will hold credits until DPA signed.
nana: (typo) sorry, meant ana: Launch gating: soft private preview when 3 partners pass onboarding w/ no P0 for 7 days. Broader private preview after 10 partners with eval pass and NPS threshold.
sam: Rollback rule: repeatable P1 within 72h -> canary rollback + incident review. Pre-accept checklist: intake form, prompt pack, infra whitelist, monitoring hooks, and trial SLA signed.
vik: I'll set up triage rules and the weekly digest channel.
tess: I'll put the prompt template into the intake form and PR the harness README by EOD.
mike: I'll manage legal/KMS gating and flag private-deploy partners.
sam: I'll update the pilot plan doc with these gates and post a recruitment note after Growth approves. :thumbsup:
